pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit a sub-polygonal to ovate geometry with significantly blurred, low-contrast edge gradients. The relative spatial area of these dark patches is roughly 3 to 4 times that of the intervening light spaces.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative space forms a continuous, interconnected lattice. Junction nodes predominantly show tri-way intersections with moderate pixel thickness that remains relatively consistent across the mid-section of the visible flank.
